sections.title: Smart money
sections.note: A wallet qualifies only if it (1) put in real money — at least $25k of buys, (2) actually sold at a profit of 5× or more (proven timing, not paper gains), and (3) still holds at least 50k SPX today (still trackable). The set is recomputed every day: wallets that dump out drop off, freshly proven winners join. We publish only the total they hold and whether they're net buying or selling — never a wallet address.

rows.label: New qualifiers (90d)
rows.note: wallets newly proven by selling tops — a spike = distribution

rows.label: Sellers' profit ratio (SOPR)
rows.note: coins that moved today sold for this multiple of their cost — above 1× = in profit

rows.label: Profit vs. loss cashed in
rows.note: dollar gains (+) minus losses (−) locked in on-chain today

rows.label: Coins waking up (liveliness)
rows.note: rising = long-dormant coins starting to move (distribution); falling = holders sitting tight

rows.label: Floor price (SPX)
rows.note: the same floor priced in SPX — AEON's SPX-native value
